Somerset Trust Company Has Trimmed Its Apple (AAPL) Stake as Stock Value Declined; Mohawk Inds (MHK) Valuation Declined While Joho Capital Has Lowered Its Position
May 21, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Somerset Trust Company decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Somerset Trust Company sold 2,434 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,389 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.97 million, down from 31,823 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Somerset Trust Company who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.86B market cap company. The stock increased 0.56% or $1.041 during the last trading session, reaching $187.351. About 13.11 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Robert Karr decreased its stake in Mohawk Inds Inc (MHK) by 12.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
